## Welcome

I am an undergraduate student in the **Department of Statistics and Data Science** at UCLA. My work focuses on using machine learning models to make predictions and linear regression to derive insights from complex datasets.

## Skills

-   **Geostatistics:** Spatial interpolation and kriging
-   **Simulations:** Developing Monte Carlo methods for modeling
-   **Machine Learning:** Fitting and optimizing predictive models

## Featured Project

**Spatial Analysis of Los Angeles Real Estate**: estimating a continuous housing price surface for the City of Los Angeles with universal kriging. [View project →](projects/la-housing-kriging.qmd)
